summary: Completed comprehensive testing of İletişim ve Bildirimler (Communication and Notifications) feature. All 23 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing verified all major features including Notification Settings page with Ayarlar/Bildirim Geçmişi tabs, E-posta/SMS toggles, NetGSM settings, notification event toggles, and action buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: All Notification APIs are properly implemented with authentication
E-posta and SMS integrations correctly return 'skipped' status when API keys/credentials are not configured
Notification settings persist correctly across requests
SLA check correctly identifies at-risk tickets and sends notifications
Mention system (@username) in comments triggers notifications correctly
All notification templates (ticket_created, ticket_assigned, ticket_resolved, sla_risk, comment_mention) are properly defined
seed_data_creation: Created test notifications (email and SMS) during backend testing. Test customer and ticket created for notification integration test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All İletişim ve Bildirimler (Communication and Notifications) features are working correctly. Backend tests cover: GET/PATCH notification settings, GET notifications list with filters, POST send manual notification, GET templates, POST SLA check, POST test-email, POST test-sms, and authentication requirements. Frontend tests verified: Bildirimler sidebar link, Notification Settings page with Ayarlar/Bildirim Geçmişi tabs, E-posta/SMS toggles, NetGSM settings section (appears when SMS enabled), all 6 notification event toggles, Ayarları Kaydet button with success toast, Test E-postası Gönder button, SLA Kontrolü Çalıştır button.
